normalized_event: A watchlist post claims the upcoming GTA VI extended look contains 26 minutes of PS5 gameplay
verification_result: Rockstar confirms the August 27 extended look, but its announcement does not establish the circulating 26-minute, 80-plus-hour, map-size, or relationship-system claims. New watchlist clips isolate apparent police-chase and open-world footage from the presentation, while other posts continue mixing official material with unsupported figures. Rockstar's reported response confirms that unauthorized gameplay leaked, but the reviewed official and reputable sources do not authenticate every circulated detail.
hold_reason: The specific duration, runtime, map-size, PS5-capture, leak-count, and gameplay-detail claims are not fully established by official materials. RapWire also will not reproduce unauthorized leaked footage or treat reposted presentation clips as rights-cleared visual assets.
